capabilities: Fetch BibTeX entries by DOI from online sources
Insert BibTeX code blocks in any note
Cite papers inline with {ID} or [ID] syntax and autocomplete
Hover citations for title, authors, abstract, and quick actions
Attach PDFs and create linked paper notes with custom templates
extras: Live Preview users are warned not to put too many entries in one BibTeX block because it may not render properly; the author also publishes pre-scraped BibTeX and Markdown files for top AI conferences, and links to example notes on an external site.
motivation: The author wants literature managed as context-rich Markdown notes instead of cluttered folder-based libraries.
problem: Traditional reference managers organize papers in flat folders without context, making it easy to lose track as the library grows.

relations.evidence: You can also use Templater plugin for more advanced functionality and customizability.

summary: BibTeX reference manager that stores citations as ```bibtex code blocks in notes and adds inline citations, hover popovers, and a search panel.
